assessment.reasoning: No promotional intervention clears the high hurdle required to generate net incremental contribution. The nearest competitor successfully passed through an ~8% price increase without losing visible share, demonstrating that category demand is price-inelastic and discounting is unnecessary to maintain competitiveness. Furthermore, 41% of Nutbox Labs' audience consists of Deal Seekers who clear carts as soon as a code lands, meaning promotional discounts will predominantly subsidize buyers with pre-existing intent or low loyalty rather than driving genuine incrementality. In a quiet seasonal stretch with high break-even incremental share requirements (18% to 20%) and a single scarce experiment that costs ~2.8x the annual promotional profit pool, risking margin on discounting is value-destructive.
